title: Minas Gerais as the centre of Brazil's UFO activity, linked to its minerals

tellings.quote: For us, there's a close relationship >> between the UFO phenomenon and the those rare elements, minerals in the whole state

plain: Minas Gerais, a Brazilian state rich in mining, is said to be the centre of the country's UFO activity because of its rare minerals. A Brazilian researcher who is not named tells Michels that "there's a close relationship between the UFO phenomenon and those rare elements, minerals in the whole state." If so, whatever is behind the sightings would be drawn to what lies in the ground there.
